verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs say it lets users manage prompts and configurations alongside models, which loosely supports saved, task-specific setups. Nothing in the evidence describes named custom assistants or personas built for specific tasks, and the Bionic agent material shows no customization. missing for 10: an explicit custom-assistant or preset feature, documentation of per-task system prompts and parameter bundles, a way to save and switch assistants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can create specialized custom assistants configured for specific tasks

citations.quote: Manage your local models, prompts, and configurations
